apps.name: American Pool 3D
apps.releaseNotes: v1.7.1 moves CHEAT and BEST SHOT physics analysis off the UI thread to prevent freezes, restores the full-size table, and overlays horizontal controls on the top-left rail.
apps.description: American Pool 3D is an original landscape 8-ball pool game with touch cue control, realistic ball-contact previews, pull-back shot power, sampled pool effects, 8-ball rules, and a computer opponent.

apps.name: Anadolu Fantasy Manager
apps.description: Anadolu Fantasy Manager is a local-first fantasy football manager for Turkish football. It uses a public GitHub JSON feed for the 2026/27 Turkish league snapshot, roster pool, news, and future fixtures/results, then keeps fantasy state on the phone with Room/DataStore. The app includes a News tab with source-linked league, transfer, data, and result items, hash-checks feed files before import, and works offline from the latest bundled or synced snapshot. It remains independent, text-only, and has no private backend, accounts, cloud league, official marks, embedded shared API key, betting, prizes, or gambling mechanics.
apps.releaseNotes: v0.1.1 public feed update: replaces the fictional demo field with the current 18-club 2026/27 Turkish league field and a 522-player roster snapshot; adds a hash-checked public GitHub data feed at yustein/AnadoluFantasyData, launch/manual Sync imports, Room feed/news tables, a News tab with source links, and preseason fixture/result placeholders. The no-central-server shape is preserved: GitHub is only the public JSON distribution repo, while squads, lineup, scoring, sharing, and friend-score state stay local. No official logos/photos/kit art, copied articles, betting, prizes, or shared provider keys are included.

apps.name: Antikythera
apps.releaseNotes: Adds the source-honest Antikythera mechanism reconstruction prototype with animated gear/dial surfaces, evidence-tier overlays, and learn/gallery/source views.
apps.description: Antikythera is an interactive reconstruction and learning tool for the ancient Antikythera mechanism. It lets you operate a 3D-style gear-and-dial model, change time, inspect calendar and eclipse-cycle readouts, and compare evidence-backed parts with more speculative reconstruction layers.

apps.name: Aurora Weather
apps.releaseNotes: Adds Smart Widget Triggers, an explicit opt-in foreground-service mode for private-store builds. Users can choose Wi-Fi/mobile network transitions and selected paired Bluetooth devices; connect/disconnect events queue a one-shot current-location weather/widget refresh with Fused Location fallback and diagnostics for location, Bluetooth, notification, and battery readiness.
apps.description: Aurora Weather is a local weather app focused on clear current conditions, forecasts, rain awareness, widgets, location-aware updates, and private-store smart triggers for selected Bluetooth devices or Wi-Fi/mobile transitions. It can follow the phone's current position, actively refresh widget weather after movement, cache recent results, and support practical daily/weather-alert workflows without requiring an account.

apps.name: Backgammon LAN
apps.releaseNotes: Adds heartbeat-notified LAN backgammon reliability improvements with Android/Windows compatible discovery, reconnect, and board sync behavior.
apps.description: Backgammon LAN is a local-network backgammon game for Android and Windows players on the same LAN. It provides a playable board, dice, legal move handling, match state sync, reconnect behavior, and local discovery so two devices can play directly without an online account.

apps.name: Bluetooth Explorer Lab
apps.releaseNotes: Initial Android release with BLE scanner, bonded-device inventory, read-only GATT service discovery, signal history, advertisement metadata, local JSON export, and no Internet permission or offensive Bluetooth writes.
apps.description: Bluetooth Explorer Lab is a local Android Bluetooth diagnostics app for scanning nearby BLE advertisements, inspecting paired devices, service UUIDs, manufacturer data, RSSI, PHY, connectability, and safely probing GATT services read-only. It exports JSON locally and intentionally uses no Internet permission.

apps.name: CalcFX
apps.releaseNotes: Publishes the latest CalcFX Android calculator prototype to NovaStore.
apps.description: CalcFX combines a polished scientific calculator with a currency exchange workspace. It supports expression preview, memory, history, degree/radian mode, advanced functions, reusable results, currency pair selection, rate refresh, offline/stale-rate display, and favorite comparison currencies.

apps.name: Carpet Measure
apps.releaseNotes: Publishes the latest AR carpet measurement prototype with corner measurement and segmentation support.
apps.description: Carpet Measure is an AR measurement prototype for estimating carpet and floor dimensions with the phone camera. It helps mark corners, inspect measured spans, and work toward area estimates using ARCore-style spatial tracking and segmentation-assisted measurement workflows.

apps.name: CatWorldly
apps.releaseNotes: Adds Crystal Paw Cavern, a Boulder Dash-style cat cave puzzler with generated bitmap cave art, swipe movement, tap-to-wait turns, fish-crystal goals, boulder pushing and falling-rock hazards, local score history, widget score support, and extracted cat voice effects.
apps.description: CatWorldly is a native companion app for the CatWorldly website. It shows daily comics, all seven weekly comic archives with back issues, fresh articles, mirrored social updates, the latest CatWorldly magazine PDF in a native reader with print/share, and a Games arcade section with Furball Pinball, Rooftop Rush, Cosmic Pawblast, and Crystal Paw Cavern. The arcade includes pause/resume, exit controls, per-game last-10 score history, how-to-play notes, tight Furball Pinball hit lighting and level-themed tables, Rooftop Rush cucumber cat-voice impacts, five escalating Cosmic Pawblast levels with colored mouse powerups and enemy return fire, and a Boulder Dash-style cave puzzler with generated bitmap cave art, swipe movement, tap-to-wait turns, fish-crystal goals, falling boulder hazards, and isolated cat voice sound effects. It checks for updates on launch and roughly every six hours, sends local notifications for new unseen items, opens content inside the app, and includes a home-screen dashboard widget with manual sync, direct Today/Comics/Games shortcuts, latest-content glances, and arcade best-score glances.

apps.name: Clawboard
apps.releaseNotes: Release-signed Clawboard store build. Carries forward the v0.2.3 AI keyboard ergonomics, dark theme controls, local snippets, notes, tasks, command templates, encrypted saved SSH passwords, and SSH terminal surface. This build migrates from prototype debug signing to a dedicated Clawboard release key.
apps.description: Clawboard is a custom Android keyboard and companion manager for working with AI systems and remote hosts. It provides AI prompt snippets, Markdown/code helper keys, local notes and tasks, user-tunable keyboard colors, terminal shortcut keys, encrypted saved SSH passwords, and an SSH command terminal in the manager app.

apps.name: ClawChat
apps.releaseNotes: Adds a Sync-tab Background check frequency control with 5 sec, 1 min, 5 min, and 60 min choices. The saved interval controls ClawChat automatic background scan/import checks and the Syncthing folder rescan interval while ClawChat is in the background. Manual scans and sends still run immediately; the default remains 1 min.
apps.description: ClawChat is an Android-first private messenger for no-phone-number chat. It creates a local cryptographic identity, pairs devices with invites, syncs encrypted message events through embedded Syncthing, supports attachments and voice messages, delivered/read receipts, local notifications, opt-in background sync, network-aware pause/resume, and a background check frequency control for battery savings.

Clawcycle Havoc is a funny fullscreen Android arcade game about a misfit cat crew tearing through eight Istanbul night districts on chrome cruiser motorcycles. It combines touch steering, larger readable level and gang-rider selection controls, selectable Easy/Normal/Hard difficulty, a 30-minute 128 kbps baked background music bed with approved source-level crossmixed transitions and rare 5-second engine handoff at the loop point, a persisted MUSIC ON/OFF toggle, a visible 9-life survival system, a selectable five-cat gang leader, large PAUSE/EXIT controls, BOOST/HAVOC/WHEELIE actions, audible 3-2-1-MEOW countdown cues, distance-based speed ramping, a HOW TO PLAY guide, fish/yarn/ramp/wrench pickups, cones and smoke hazards, combo scoring, generated bitmap artwork, Tony-provided cat voices, and claw-scratch/paw HAVOC effects. It is a standalone no-network game and uses generic cruiser styling with no motorcycle-brand logos.
apps.name: Clawcycle Havoc
apps.releaseNotes: v0.1.12 compression update: keeps the approved 30-minute baked crossmix playback behavior, but re-renders the embedded music bed at 128 kbps instead of 192 kbps and moves the old short source-track MP3s out of packaged Android resources. Gameplay, MUSIC ON/OFF, 9-life system, difficulty tuning, package identity, signing identity, and the rare 5-second end-of-bed loop handoff remain unchanged.

apps.name: ClawDeck
apps.releaseNotes: Keeps live OpenClaw chat sessions running in the background with a foreground chat service and partial wake lock.
apps.description: ClawDeck is an Android-first OpenClaw operations console. It keeps saved server targets, SSH command surfaces, safe command templates, local operator notes, chat with OpenClaw, background chat keepalive, logs, redaction, and a setup flow for managing Tony's own infrastructure from a phone.

apps.name: CleanBass EQ
apps.releaseNotes: Fixes the stuck Waiting for audio session path by adding an automatic legacy output-mix fallback when Spotify does not expose a public Android audio-effect session. CleanBass EQ still listens for real Spotify sessions and switches away from the fallback if one appears; Refresh now retries detection.
apps.description: CleanBass EQ is a precision Android equalizer for real-world wireless listening. It focuses on clean, strong bass and clipping protection for Spotify with a Redmi Note 13 Pro+ 5G, LDAC, Dolby Atmos, and Huawei FreeBuds 7i setup. It uses Android public audio effect APIs, listens for live app audio sessions, and now tries Android legacy output-mix fallback when Spotify does not expose a session. Android 14+ runs it as a connected-device foreground service with Bluetooth permission rather than a media playback service. The Tony Bass profile includes Dolby-aware tuning, Spotify setup checks, automatic headroom protection, three-part bass quality control, blind A/B tuning, JSON profile exchange, and honest playback-only call limitations.

apps.name: Code Ancients
apps.releaseNotes: Adds animated book-geometry overlays to the 3D globe: the Shark-tail kite, Panther-tail kite, and Giza-Nazca-Easter alignment. Adds a Geometry toggle, Next shape control, active-shape subtitle, shape source notes, and auto-focus on the active geometry. Keeps the full offline book reader, 34 location records, Giza/Greenwich meridians, and no Android permissions.
apps.description: Code Ancients is a companion atlas-reader for Tony Yustein's Code of the Ancients. It combines a rotatable 3D globe with animated book-geometry overlays, selectable Earth pins, Giza prime-meridian visualization, full extracted book text, location coordinate/math notes, public context, and bundled site imagery in an offline Android app.

apps.name: Echo Atlas
apps.releaseNotes: Publishes the latest Echo Atlas Android prototype to NovaStore.
apps.description: Echo Atlas is an experimental sensor-driven exploration game. It blends touch, motion, microphone, camera light, GPS, battery, and device-state signals into an anomaly-hunting interface where the player tunes signals, stabilizes or harvests discoveries, and reads changing visual feedback.

apps.name: File Atlas
apps.releaseNotes: Publishes the latest File Atlas Android prototype to NovaStore.
apps.description: File Atlas is a phone file manager for browsing local storage with a practical dashboard, folders, file categories, search, sort modes, recent/storage context, file details, open/share actions, rename, delete, and path copying. It is designed for direct on-device file work.

apps.name: Gateway Fieldbook
apps.releaseNotes: Publishes the recovered Gateway Fieldbook v1.3.0 build to NovaStore.
apps.description: Gateway Fieldbook is a field journal and training companion rebuilt from Tony's recovered APK. It includes focus timers, guided sessions, tone/audio exercises, profile and log tools, remote-viewing style practice targets, and structured notes for recording observations during sessions.

apps.name: GPU Video Combiner
apps.releaseNotes: Initial Android release with a multi-video picker, reorder/remove/clear queue controls, output size and fit options, H.264/HEVC choices, visible encoding progress, cancel/share actions, and local-only MediaCodec processing.
apps.description: GPU Video Combiner is a local Android video tool for joining selected clips into one MP4. It lets you order a clip queue, choose output size, fit mode, codec, and audio behavior, then export through Android hardware encoding and save the result to Movies/GPUVideoCombiner.

apps.name: I Ching Journal
apps.releaseNotes: Adds five selectable reading translation lenses: Legge classic, Wilhelm/Baynes, Blofeld oracle, Cleary practical, and Rutt/Shaughnessy historical. The modern tradition lenses use original rights-safe wording and can change the active reading anytime. Journal entries remember the selected lens. No Android permissions.
apps.description: I Ching Journal is a private, no-permission Android oracle and reflection app. It casts six-line I Ching readings with traditional virtual coin probabilities, supports one-card, three-card, and five-card spreads, lets readers switch among five translation lenses anytime, explains changing lines and transformed hexagrams, shows oracle card graphics, lets you browse all 64 hexagrams, and saves readings locally on the device.

apps.name: Lenomila PDF
apps.releaseNotes: v0.1.1 zoom fix. Zoom buttons now change the displayed page width instead of only increasing render resolution, and two-finger pinch zoom updates the same bounded zoom state. Keeps Android PDF VIEW default-app intent filters, Android PdfRenderer rendering, Storage Access Framework open/save, scoped FileProvider sharing, and the same narrow no-Internet/no-broad-storage permission profile.
apps.description: Lenomila PDF is a native Android PDF viewer for local documents. It opens PDFs from Android file/document providers, can be chosen as the default PDF viewer through Android's Open with / Always flow, renders pages on device, offers button and pinch zoom controls, saves a copy through the system document picker, and shares the current PDF through Android share targets without requiring broad storage access.

apps.name: Lenomila Upscaler
apps.releaseNotes: Initial release. Adds local on-device Real-ESRGAN image upscaling through NCNN/Vulkan, Android image picker and share-intent support, pinch-zoom preview, PNG save/share controls, bundled official lightweight Real-ESRGAN NCNN models, and no Internet or broad storage permissions.
apps.description: Lenomila Upscaler is a local Android image upscaler. It opens images through Android document providers or share intents, runs Real-ESRGAN style upscaling on the phone through NCNN/Vulkan with bundled lightweight model files, previews the result with pinch zoom, and saves or shares a PNG without Internet or broad storage permissions.

apps.name: Metatron Music
apps.description: Metatron Music is a polished local Android music player for FLAC, WAV, MP3, AAC, OGG, and other Android-supported audio files. It indexes user-selected folders and files through Android Storage Access Framework, can use OneDrive-backed document-provider files when the provider exposes them, supports recursive subdirectory shuffle, playlists, album and folder browsing, search, favorites, background playback, lockscreen, Bluetooth, and Xiaomi media-session controls, an in-app car mode with large buttons, sleep timer, and Android equalizer handoff. It uses no account, backend, network permission, broad storage permission, notification permission, overlay permission, tracking, or cloud credentials.
apps.releaseNotes: v0.1.14 latched playback controls update: shuffle, repeat/loop, and selected sleep timer buttons now stay visibly pressed until the user unselects them; selected shuffle/repeat modes carry into newly started queues; selecting the same active timer again turns it off.

apps.name: MuzoPlay
apps.releaseNotes: Fixes Sports tab freezes by moving EPG sports schedule discovery off the main UI thread, caching sports/date results, and showing a preparing state while large XMLTV guides are scanned. Also includes external subtitle discovery for provider metadata and sidecar subtitle files.
apps.description: MuzoPlay is a neutral IPTV/media player for user-supplied playlists. It imports M3U/M3U8 and XMLTV-style guide data, plays live streams with Media3/ExoPlayer or the bundled VLC software decoder, enriches user-owned movie/show catalogs with optional TMDB metadata when the user provides a token, supports local reminders and customization, and intentionally includes no bundled channels, subscriptions, provider credentials, or public stream lists.

apps.name: NovaStore
apps.releaseNotes: Final compatibility update for legacy NovaStore installs that still use package com.novastore.client. Install this same-package update first, then install the modern com.lenomila.novastore NovaStore line if it is not already present.
apps.description: This NovaStore entry is a compatibility bridge for older NovaStore 0.1.x installations that used the original com.novastore.client package. It lets those installs update to the final old-package build before moving to the modern NovaStore package.

apps.name: NovaStore
apps.releaseNotes: Adds Google TV and Leanback launcher support, a branded TV banner, Apps-first remote navigation, strong D-pad focus, and a TV-safe Search dialog. Phone navigation and the verified APK hash/signature plus Android-owned installer handoff remain unchanged.
apps.description: NovaStore is Tony's private Android app store for signed APK releases hosted on GitHub, now usable on phones and Google TV with touch or D-pad navigation. It shows trusted app listings, checks installed versions only for catalog apps, verifies catalog signatures plus APK hashes, and hands installs or updates to Android with normal user approval.

apps.name: PhantomXRay
apps.releaseNotes: Updates PhantomXRay with a more biological skeleton overlay: skull, clavicles, ribs, pelvis, joint capsules, and paired limb bones read less like prop bones over the camera.
apps.description: PhantomXRay is an entertainment camera AR app that overlays a stylized skeleton and skull effect on people in the camera preview. It uses on-device pose/face tracking for spooky visual play and is not medical imaging, diagnosis, security scanning, or a real X-ray tool.

apps.name: Prism Launcher
apps.releaseNotes: v0.2 launcher feature update. Adds Android widget hosting with explicit app-widget binding, LauncherApps pinned/deep shortcuts in search and long-press app actions, pop-up folders, local smart categories with manual overrides, gesture shortcuts for search/app drawer/favorites, and work-profile labels, quiet-state handling, and profile/category filters. Keeps the launcher local-first with no Internet, Contacts, Notifications, Accessibility, Location, Calendar, Usage Stats, QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES, installer, or broad background permissions.
apps.description: Prism Launcher is a privacy-first Android home launcher with Flow, Grid, Board, and Command home styles, LauncherApps-based profile-aware app and shortcut indexing, Room-backed local app/widget/customization state, DataStore settings, cached icons, fuzzy search, favorites, hidden apps, aliases, tags, folders, local smart categories, gesture shortcuts, Android widget hosting, theme controls, profile filters, and local JSON backup/import. It avoids ads, trackers, network calls, Accessibility, sensitive permissions, installer permissions, and broad package queries.

apps.name: Pyramid Shield
apps.releaseNotes: Replaces the bundled background music with Tony's forwarded Gemini MP3 exactly as the raw offline audio resource. Keeps the persistent Music toggle, Android MediaPlayer looping, explicit completion restart fallback, true Merkaba/star-tetrahedron geometry, per-face shading, colored base-corner markers, visual effects, and no Android permissions.
apps.description: Pyramid Shield is an offline Android visualizer for Tony's protective Merkaba concept. It renders a true star-tetrahedron field made from two interlocking regular tetrahedra, one upright and one inverted, with fixed per-face shade variation and colored base-corner markers for easier rotation tracking, comet-style motion trails, lighting, optional color flow, animated texture, pulse boost, speed, solidity, intensity, touch camera movement, and a bundled continuous background music loop controlled by a persistent Music toggle. Version 0.1.10 uses Tony's forwarded Gemini background MP3 exactly as the bundled 30.824 second stereo track.

apps.name: Quake Globe
apps.releaseNotes: Google TV compatibility update: adds a Leanback launcher and TV banner, visible D-pad focus, remote globe rotation/zoom/selection controls, remote Back focus recovery, and in-app Custom Tabs for source links.
apps.description: Quake Globe is an earthquake monitor with a live 3D globe, recent USGS earthquake feeds, selectable event markers/details, and configurable local notifications. It supports Google TV/Android TV with a Leanback launcher and D-pad globe controls, visualizes magnitude, depth, location, and recency, and keeps alerts local and source-honest.

apps.name: Resonance Finder
apps.releaseNotes: Publishes the first Resonance Finder Android APK to NovaStore.
apps.description: Resonance Finder is a science prototype for exploring frequency, vibration, and resonance ideas on Android. It is intended as a lightweight companion for finding or thinking through resonant behavior, experiments, and signal relationships rather than as a calibrated laboratory instrument.

apps.name: Resonance Lab
apps.releaseNotes: Publishes the latest Resonance Lab acoustic prototype to NovaStore.
apps.description: Resonance Lab is an acoustic resonance field prototype. It plays controlled sine sweeps, records microphone response, estimates the strongest local response peak, and can play detected frequencies back with steady, pulsed, or wobbling output for visible small-object experiments.

apps.name: Secutor
apps.description: Secutor is a local-first secure packet utility. It keeps private keys inside encrypted on-device real or decoy vaults, creates transport-neutral encrypted packet files/text with X25519 + ML-KEM-768 hybrid encryption and Ed25519 + ML-DSA-65 signatures, supports AES-GCM or ChaCha20-Poly1305 payloads, sequence/replay protection, encrypted attachment chunks with responsive background handling, large attachment packet output that avoids rendering multi-megabyte packet text on screen, self-destruct policies with a one-minute read window, local Shamir recovery, multiple identities, optional emergency key destruction, restricted-message screenshot blocking, public invites, detailed guided Help, 13 supported app languages, device-credential unlock fallback on modern Android, and offline transport handoff without accounts or Internet permission.
apps.releaseNotes: v0.2.9 image attachment ANR, status expiry, and guided Help update: fixes the remaining image self-send freeze by moving packet encryption/import/save work onto background dispatchers and replacing the on-screen multi-megabyte packet text field with a large-packet action card while preserving Copy, Save, and Share. Adds Android device-credential unlock support on API 30+ so a hardware PIN can unlock Secutor when strong biometrics are unavailable, auto-clears stale non-progress status messages after a short delay, and expands Help with translated step-by-step install, first setup, two-person exchange, and send-to-yourself testing instructions. Keeps package com.lenomila.cipherpacket, no Internet permission, the Antarctica signing certificate, Android signing lineage, the v0.2.5 picker compatibility fix, v0.2.6 emergency destruction, v0.2.7 restricted-message/transport fixes, and v0.2.8 localization/attachment progress work.

apps.name: Solar Flyover
apps.releaseNotes: First practical accurate Solar Flyover release with offline realtime planet positions, 3D flyover navigation, labels, orbit trails, time controls, Earth/selected-body centering, and accurate/compressed distance modes.
apps.description: Solar Flyover is an offline 3D solar system model built for practical accuracy. It computes realtime or accelerated planet positions from JPL/NASA-style orbital elements, lets users fly around the system, inspect planets, follow Earth or selected bodies, view orbit trails, and switch between accurate AU distances and a phone-friendly compressed display.

apps.name: Solfege Lens
apps.releaseNotes: Improves Solfege Lens as a solfege singing and teaching app: Turkish-pronounced Do/Re/Mi playback regardless of UI language, removes ABC-style labels from the user-facing sequence, filters time signatures, key signatures, tempo marks, ties, slurs, and beams from singable notes, and adds basic meter/tempo/key/rhythm/phrasing heuristics for more song-like playback.
apps.description: Solfege Lens is a music-learning prototype that turns a sheet-music image into guided solfege playback. It detects treble-clef staff systems and likely noteheads on-device, labels notes as Do/Re/Mi/Fa/Sol/La/Si, speaks each syllable with Turkish solfege pronunciation regardless of UI language, can add or mute a generated pitch tone, offers reading speed selection, keeps the display awake while open, filters common sheet signs from note playback, estimates simple meter/tempo/key/rhythm/phrasing context, and can show the current note in a zoom window while keeping the main sheet readable.

apps.name: SpeedCockpit
apps.releaseNotes: Publishes the latest SpeedCockpit build with map cockpit modes, stricter speed-limit display, warning tones, and reduced map tile flicker.
apps.description: SpeedCockpit is a driving cockpit with GPS speed, map context, speed-limit focused display, warning tones, and multiple map/cockpit modes. It is built for glanceable travel use with reduced map flicker and stricter speed-limit presentation.

apps.name: Speed Test Lab
apps.releaseNotes: Publishes the latest Speed Test Lab Android prototype to NovaStore.
apps.description: Speed Test Lab measures network latency, jitter, download speed, upload speed, active Wi-Fi/mobile transport details, public IP/provider metadata when reachable, and local test history. It uses public endpoints and presents results for comparing network quality over time.

apps.name: TorrentAtlas
apps.releaseNotes: Fixes Android startup for the pure-Java Bt engine by using the Android-safe Guice no-AOP runtime, removes the Android-incompatible Apache HttpClient tracker module, and verifies launch, magnet adds, and .torrent URL adds in the release APK.
apps.description: TorrentAtlas is a torrent search and download manager for legal/open torrents and user-provided magnet or .torrent files. It can browse supported sources, add downloads, track progress, and use a pure-Java BitTorrent engine without bundling native libtorrent components.

apps.name: Turbo Pitlane GP
apps.releaseNotes: Fresh v0.2.0 rebuild from scratch: new chase-view race loop, drag steering pad, BOOST and DRIFT controls, five circuit selector, bigger player car, denser rivals, pickups, damage, combo scoring, corrected landscape menu layout, and phone-tested APK.
apps.description: Turbo Pitlane GP is a phone-tested chase-view arcade racing game with five selectable circuits, drag steering, BOOST/DRIFT controls, a larger player car, dense rival traffic, turbo/service/apex pickups, damage, near-miss combo scoring, SoundPool racing effects, and no network play.

apps.name: Turkey Tourism
apps.releaseNotes: Publishes the latest Turkey Tourism travel guide prototype to NovaStore.
apps.description: Turkey Tourism is a travel guide for exploring Turkey with place information, guide-style profiles, travel scoring, weather context, detail pages, images, and in-app web references. It is built for trip planning and quick tourist orientation while staying inside the app.

apps.name: TVForge Link
apps.releaseNotes: First usable alpha companion with authenticated TV pairing, encrypted and replay-protected status/transfer/control, D-pad/Select/Back/Home remote actions, bounded text entry, signed-feed proposal, and foreground-only TVForge control.
apps.description: TVForge Link is the Android companion for TVForge on Google TV. It pairs over the local network with matching phrase and explicit TV approval, then uses encrypted replay-protected requests for APK transfer, job observation, signed-feed proposals, and a bounded TVForge-only remote. It does not require ADB, Accessibility, root, hidden APIs, or a cloud account in standard mode.

apps.name: TVForge
apps.releaseNotes: First usable alpha: remote-first Google TV app inventory, Android-confirmed APK receive/inspect/install, trusted signed feeds and updates, durable transfer history, TVForge Link pairing/remote control, diagnostics, and English/Turkish UI.
apps.description: TVForge is a remote-first Google TV utility for receiving, inspecting, installing, finding, launching, and updating Android apps with explicit Android confirmation. It supports authenticated local browser and TVForge Link transfers, signed publisher feeds, durable recovery, package identity inspection, diagnostics, and English/Turkish UI. The direct build has comprehensive local package inventory and never claims silent installation.

apps.name: Ultimate Tarot
apps.releaseNotes: Adds a white full-card chapter reading surface, reading-level sharing as full text, and graphical PDF sharing with card images and full reading text. Reversed cards are shown reversed in readings and PDF exports. No Android permissions.
apps.description: Ultimate Tarot is a private, no-permission Android tarot reading and study app built from Tony Yustein's Tarot Mastery book and public-domain card images. It supports rich card art, one-card through advanced multi-card spreads, detailed book-derived interpretations, reversals, timing, full book browsing, deck search, and local journaling.

apps.name: UniWhisper
apps.releaseNotes: Adds local offline daily reminders with Android notification permission, reminder time controls, Android alarm scheduling, reboot/update rescheduling, and daily notification text from the bundled UniWhisper message library. No Firebase, runtime AI, internet, or exact-alarm permission is used.
apps.description: UniWhisper is an offline symbolic reflection app with daily universe messages, optional local reminder notifications, reflective questions, grounded actions, Ask Universe prompts, local journaling, and searchable curated messages. It stores user data locally, uses no runtime AI, and presents messages as reflection rather than prediction or professional advice.

apps.name: Virtual Atlas Walk
apps.releaseNotes: Restores a small controlled zoom-out range (zoomMin = -0.3) instead of disabling zoom-out entirely, while keeping the Android same-contact pinch rebound guard that prevents zoom-out gestures from flipping into the extreme close-up. Image changes still reset to neutral zoom.
apps.description: Virtual Atlas Walk is an offline-first Android guided walk atlas for archaeological and touristic places. It uses bundled public-source imagery, local guide text, route facts, travel notes, photo-panel 3D movement, stable pinch/wheel zoom and orbit controls, and optional downloadable location packs.

apps.name: Visit Video Logger
apps.releaseNotes: Extends the right-panel transparency slider to 100% so the info/map panel can be fully transparent, and adds an Exit app button to Settings. Exit app stops and saves an active recording before closing.
apps.description: Visit Video Logger records driving or travel videos with a composed camera, map, GPS, heading, speed, timestamp, optional front-camera picture-in-picture, black-screen mode, localized UI, weather units, and configurable right-panel transparency.

apps.name: WaveAtlas Radio
apps.description: WaveAtlas Radio is a global online radio player using the public Radio Browser directory. It supports Google TV/Android TV with a Leanback launcher and D-pad navigation; discovers stations by genre, country, or search; plays through Android Media3 foreground playback; shows station/song metadata when available; keeps favorites and an on-device SQLite directory cache; opens station sites in-app; and requires no account, tracking profile, private backend, central server, or bundled paid stream provider.
apps.releaseNotes: Google TV compatibility update: adds a Leanback launcher and TV banner, television-safe wide spacing, and visible D-pad focus for navigation, filters, station cards, favorite/play actions, the player dock, and Now controls. Phone launch no longer opens the search keyboard automatically.

apps.name: WaveAtlas TV
apps.description: WaveAtlas TV is a worldwide internet TV viewer with a bundled public station/feed catalog. It supports Google TV/Android TV with a Leanback launcher, two-pane television layout, and D-pad navigation; lets you search and filter, save favorites, play through Media3 with VLC fallback, choose streams/tracks, use Picture-in-Picture, and control fullscreen/aspect modes. Adult/NSFW-capable records are included but hidden unless the explicit Adult toggle is enabled. Public streams can be offline, temporary, or geo-blocked.
apps.releaseNotes: Google TV compatibility update: adds a Leanback launcher and TV banner, a television two-pane player/catalog layout, visible D-pad focus and deterministic remote navigation, persistent fullscreen remote controls, and both ARM64 and ARMv7 VLC libraries for broader television hardware support.

apps.name: WaveVid
apps.releaseNotes: Publishes the latest WaveVid Android media prototype to NovaStore.
apps.description: WaveVid turns one image plus one audio file into a 720p MP4 with a full-width blue waveform along the bottom. It runs encoding on-device with Android media codecs, saves output to Movies/WaveVid, and can continue rendering in a foreground service.

apps.name: Whisper Scribe
apps.releaseNotes: Fixes local Whisper blank transcripts by using whisper.cpp auto language transcription correctly instead of language-detection-only mode. Adds explicit empty-result messages, clearer short-recording status, and multilingual local model download options while preserving OpenAI API mode.
apps.description: Whisper Scribe records or imports audio on Android and turns speech into editable text. It supports high-quality OpenAI API transcription plus free local offline Whisper via whisper.cpp after downloading or importing a model, then lets users copy, save, or share transcripts.

apps.name: WiFi Spectrum Lab
apps.releaseNotes: Initial Android release with live Wi-Fi scan lists, channel congestion views for 2.4/5/6 GHz, WPA/WPA2/WPA3/OWE/WEP/open security scoring, signal history, connected-network context, vendor hints, and local JSON report export. It intentionally uses no Internet permission and stays within Android user-approved Wi-Fi/location scan limits.
apps.description: WiFi Spectrum Lab is a local Android Wi-Fi analyzer for inspecting nearby access points without sending scan data off the phone. It shows SSID/BSSID, signal strength, channel, band, channel width, security posture, vendor hints, connected-network context, channel congestion, signal history, and JSON report export while respecting Android scan throttling and permission limits.

apps.name: World Cup 2026
apps.releaseNotes: Adds local match-alert notifications: kickoff alerts just before matches, periodic ESPN scoreboard monitoring, goal alerts with scorer/minute/type/team/score when ESPN provides the detail, and full-time result alerts.
apps.description: World Cup 2026 is a tournament companion for fixtures, kickoff times, teams, venues, match status, results, news, and daily brief-style schedule checks. It is designed to show real local-time match information and open related web content inside the app.
